Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake agent: 3 questions, you confirm (stop); Socratic mentor, chapter by chapter (agent); Structure architect: the outline (agent); Socratic mentor and argument builder: the stress test (agent); Chapter plan and INSIGHT collection (agent) | paper: Intake agent: 3 questions, you confirm (stop); Socratic mentor, chapter by chapter, given each answer (agent); The mentor's question (stop); Structure architect: the outline (agent); Socratic mentor and argument builder: the stress test (agent); Chapter plan and INSIGHT collection (agent); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
